#!/bin/bash
# Runs once, as root, before the agent starts: Harbor's [environment.healthcheck] unpacks this folder into
# /var/lib/mimo and runs it. Generated by mimo_harbor; see its README for how each step maps to Xiaomi's harness.
M=/var/lib/mimo
[ -f "$M/ready" ] && exit 0
chmod 700 "$M"
fail() { echo "setup: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
# the answer-leak blocklist (mimoagent), applied to /etc/hosts by the agent right after it installs
write_blocklist() { cp "$M/files/blocklist" "$M/blocklist"; }

# Terminal-Bench rows (in the General domain): the Harbor convention itself. Scrub test leftovers from the image and
# remember what was in the workspace, so harness residue can be told apart from the agent's work at grading time.
rm -rf /tests
find /logs/verifier -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
ls -A /app 2>/dev/null > "$M/before" || true

# env-prefetch-network@1: grading imports this module; fetch while the network is open.
python3 -m pip install cryptography > "$M/env-prefetch-network.log" 2>&1 || fail "env-prefetch-network@1 cannot install cryptography"
touch "$M/ready"
echo "setup done"

schema_version = "1.4"

[task]
name = "mimo-v2.6-rl/candidate-2376-security-cryptography"
description = "Repair Authlib JOSE key provenance across JWS and JWE and emit a regression report."
keywords = ["mimo-v2.6-rl", "terminal"]

[metadata]
adapter = "mimo_harbor 1.1.0"
category = "Terminal tasks"
domain = "terminal"
keywords = ["terminal", "Terminal tasks", "Terminal-bench style", "English", "security_repair", "jose", "cryptography", "python"]
original_allow_internet = false
reference_harness = "XiaomiMiMo/verl a2ad9f6 + XiaomiMiMo/mimoagent 467f0a1"
reference_step_limit = 500
source_dataset = "XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-RL-oss"
source_id = "candidate-2376-security-cryptography"
source_revision = "639865fd3374018d6cb29b9fb82dd531406fcf5f"
title = "Repair Authlib JOSE key provenance across JWS and JWE and emit a regression report."

[agent]
timeout_sec = 900.0

[verifier]
timeout_sec = 240.0
user = "root"

[environment]
docker_image = "docker.io/xiaomimimo/mimo-v2.6-rl-oss@sha256:090c12b68da2bbe3d0d2872204b1e56a377f895090f0132aba20dbe51a8a60ca"
workdir = "/app"
cpus = 1
memory_mb = 2048
storage_mb = 10240
network_mode = "public"
build_timeout_sec = 1800.0

[environment.healthcheck]
# one-time setup before the agent (environment/setup/setup.sh)
command = "bash -c 'test -f /var/lib/mimo/ready || { mkdir -p /var/lib/mimo && echo  | base64 -d | tar -xzf - -C /var/lib/mimo && bash /var/lib/mimo/setup.sh; }'"
timeout_sec = 1200.0
retries = 0
interval_sec = 5.0

rationale: Terminal grader imports fail with ModuleNotFoundError (candidate-2376-security-cryptography); install cryptography at setup while the network is open (env-prefetch-network@1, HAR-146 shape).
